name: Trust
desc: Collect and manage video and text testimonials from your customers.

actions.name: create_testimonial
actions.description: Creates a new testimonial in the system.

actions.name: update_testimonial
actions.description: Updates an existing testimonial in the system.

actions.name: create_contact
actions.description: Creates a new contact in the system.

actions.name: update_contact
actions.description: Updates an existing contact in the system.

actions.name: find_contact
actions.description: Finds a contact by ID or email address.

actions.name: upload_image
actions.description: Uploads an image to the Trust media library.

actions.name: upload_video
actions.description: Uploads a video to the Trust media library for use in testimonials.

actions.name: upload_small_video
actions.description: Uploads a short video to the Trust media library.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_testimonial
triggers.description: Triggers when a new testimonial is created in your Trust workspace.
